name: AniList Scrobbler
description: Watches Jellyfin playback and updates your AniList list as you go. Each Jellyfin user links their own AniList account. Episodes are matched by AniList, MyAnimeList or AniDB id, with a title search as a fallback, and progress is only ever moved forward.
overview: Track anime watching in Jellyfin and log it to AniList.

versions.changelog: Initial release: episode and film scrobbling to AniList.
